answer: Require every agent to lock a bond in a vault before it can earn: the stake is slashed when peers judge its work fake, so each fake identity costs real money upfront. Add a live pulse check, where each identity must regularly prove distinct, ongoing work, so clones cannot idle cheaply. An attacker seeding a yarrow patch of sockpuppets must fund and maintain every single one, and losing the bond on each makes mass fakery unprofitable.
